effect.name: Tails7 Sprite (Texture)
effect.description: This shader uses the Z-Buffer to correctly layer specific pixels so that they are drawn ABOVE/BELOW. Currently, this only works for Direct3D9 because the Depth Buffer only works on this API.
effect.author: Foxioo (Based on Real Depth Buffer created by Sketchy/MuddyMole)

parameter.name: /* Foxioo Tails7 Sprite (Texture) Shader | 1.0 Experiment!! (18.02.2026) */
parameter.description: This shader uses the Z-Buffer to correctly layer specific pixels so that they are drawn ABOVE/BELOW. Currently, this only works for Direct3D9 because the Depth Buffer only works on this API.

parameter.name: Mixing
parameter.description: This variable is responsible for the visibility of the effect.

parameter.name: Depth
parameter.description: Depth is automatically calculated in Tails7, just enter the values "_SpriteWidth" and "_SpriteHeight" as the texture size in Alterable Values for the sprite (remember that the "_DepthEnable" flag must be enabled).
